summary: Vectoree is a backend for AI coding agents: models, templates, tools, auth, database and storage. Its model gateway is OpenAI-compatible with one project key across providers including xAI, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and DeepSeek. Sign-up and the basics are free with no monthly fee; after logging in with the CLI and linking a project, the account gets $5, enough to try models and Tool Hub. Further gateway use is paid from a Stripe-funded org wallet billed per model; an empty wallet cannot call the gateway.
claim_steps: Sign up at vectoree.ai and create a project
Log in with the CLI: npx @vectoree/cli login --api-url https://vectoree.ai
Link the project with the CLI to receive the $5 welcome credit
Pick a model (e.g. vectoree/auto) and call the OpenAI-compatible gateway
